name: Xevious
notes: This board was withheld from the previous batch and is publishable now only because harvest() drops a contested cell instead of taking whichever reading came last. Its parts list claims 1 cell(s) twice.
Xevious is Namco's game, distributed by Atari, and its TM-230 follows Atari's house format — another check that the harvest depends on the manual's format rather than on who designed the board.
Column-first designators, recorded in grid.transposed rather than inferred.
No component-location drawing has been read. The grid spacing is nominal.
conflicts: 1 designator(s) dropped as claimed twice within the one printing — with a single printing there is nothing to arbitrate with. They are listed by the merge and reproduced in the commit.

MAME's ROM map for this machine was NOT applied. MAME names each ROM by the board it sits on, and this hardware is more than one board: 8 of MAME's 25 positions fall off this grid and their kinds include 'pals_vidbd' and 'sub-CPU program' — MAME is naming a video board and a sub-CPU board this map is not. Xevious is Namco multi-board hardware. The site's MAME ROM-map page for the machine is unaffected — it never claimed a PCB — but nothing from it is placed on this map until someone attributes MAME's positions to a board.
